verdict.rationale: First-party docs say users can delegate complex, multi-step work to Computer and receive structured results. Tasks keep running in the background: the server sends progress notifications, and the client can re-poll with the same thread_id while the task is still running. Approval and clarification relays let the user review sensitive actions mid-task. missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration of autonomous background task completion; documentation of the background-and-review flow in the consumer Computer UI rather than only via the MCP interface.
